tasks.gr9-listening-speaking-t1: Topic: Speeches, discussions, listening comprehension, interviews, and fluency. Cover short speech structure, active listening, critical discussion engagement, interview techniques, and polite classroom interaction. Ask Grade 9 learners to identify best presentation practices, choose appropriate listening strategies, recognize polite language forms, and demonstrate understanding of fluency markers.
tasks.gr9-reading-viewing-t1: Topic: Short stories, visual texts, poetry, theme analysis, and conflict resolution. Cover theme identification through evidence, tone detection, conflict types, supporting evidence from text, and visual element analysis. Ask Grade 9 learners to interpret themes, find tone markers, trace conflict development, use quotations effectively, and analyze visual design choices.
tasks.gr9-writing-presenting-t1: Topic: Narrative and descriptive essays, personal reflection, friendly letters, and planning strategies. Cover essay structure, paragraph unity, topic sentences, descriptive language use, audience awareness, and prewriting techniques. Ask Grade 9 learners to organize ideas logically, maintain tone consistency, develop supporting details, and plan writing effectively.
tasks.gr9-language-structures-t1: Topic: Tenses, idiomatic vocabulary, concords, direct and indirect speech, and punctuation. Cover tense usage in context, concord agreement, idiomatic phrases, speech conversion, and sentence punctuation. Ask Grade 9 learners to use tenses correctly, apply concord rules, identify idioms, convert speech forms, and demonstrate punctuation mastery.
